chart.name: Network bytes/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('counter.total_net_output_bytes', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A')
B = data('counter.total_net_input_bytes', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'),rollup='rate').publish(label='B')

chart.name: CPU utilization (%)
chart.programText:
A = data('counter.used_cpu_sys', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'), rollup='rate').scale(100).publish(label='A')
B = data('counter.used_cpu_user', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'), rollup='rate').scale(100).publish(label='B')

chart.name: Used memory
chart.programText: A = data('bytes.used_memory_rss', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info')).publish(label='A')

chart.name: # Connected clients

chart.name: Operations/sec
chart.programText: A = data('counter.commands_processed', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A')

chart.name: Evicted & expired keys /sec
chart.programText:
A = data('counter.evicted_keys', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'),rollup='rate').publish(label='A')
B = data('counter.expired_keys', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'),rollup='rate').publish(label='B')

chart.name: Cache hit rate %
chart.programText:
A = data('derive.keyspace_hits', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'), rollup='sum', extrapolation='last_value').sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('derive.keyspace_misses', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'), rollup='sum', extrapolation='last_value').sum().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A+1)/(A+1+B)*100).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Blocked and rejected clients
chart.programText:
A = data('gauge.blocked_clients', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info')).publish(label='A')
B = data('counter.rejected_connections', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'),rollup='rate').publish(label='B')

chart.name: Mode
chart.programText:
A = data('gauge.slave_repl_offset', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info')).count().publish(label='A')
B = data('gauge.master_repl_offset', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info')).count().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B-A).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Memory bytes used
chart.programText:
A = data('bytes.used_memory', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info')).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).min().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
F = (A).max().publish(label='F')

chart.name: CPU utilization (%)
chart.programText:
A = data('counter.used_cpu_sys', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'), rollup='rate').scale(100).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('counter.used_cpu_user', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'), rollup='rate').scale(100).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A+B).publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (C).min().publish(label='D')
E = (C).percentile(pct=10).publish(label='E')
F = (C).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='F')
G = (C).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='G')
H = (C).max().publish(label='H')
AB = alerts(autodetect_id='FadUmhaAcAA').publish(label='Autodetect alerts')

chart.name: Top operations/sec

chart.name: # Instances

chart.description: Should match leader replication offsets closely
chart.name: Follower replication offsets
chart.programText: A = data('gauge.slave_repl_offset', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info')).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Leader replication offsets
chart.programText: A = data('gauge.master_repl_offset', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info')).above(1, inclusive=True).publish(label='A')

chart.name: Lowest cache hit rate
chart.programText:
A = data('derive.keyspace_hits', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'), rollup='sum').mean(by=['plugin_instance']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('derive.keyspace_misses', filter=filter('plugin', 'redis_info'), rollup='sum').mean(by=['plugin_instance']).publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A+1)/(A+1+B)*100).bottom(count=5).publish(label='C')
